fr.recommendations:
• Mark the driveway entrance with reflective address numbers visible from both directions on the road.
• Install a reflective address marker at the driveway entry to help responders locate the property quickly at night or in low visibility.
• Keep the path between the main residence and detached structures clear of parked vehicles and stored equipment so responders can move between buildings without obstruction.
• Mark or label detached structures to help responders identify them quickly on arrival.
• Keep the storage area clear of materials stacked against or directly adjacent to any structure walls.
• Clear a walking path along the rear of the main residence to allow responders to reach the back of the property without passing through the vehicle parking area.
• Keep the vehicle parking area organized so arriving emergency vehicles have a clear staging area near the main entrance.
• If any gate or barrier controls access to the rear of the property, keep it unlocked or install a quick-release mechanism for emergency entry.
• Maintain the open lawn area free of large equipment or stored materials that would block movement or staging for responding crews.

wildfire.recommendations:
• Trim shrubs that are growing directly next to the house and any other structures on the property.
• Thin scattered shrubs between structures to create open gaps and reduce the chance of fire moving from one to another.
• Keep all access routes clear of shrub growth and low-hanging branches so vehicles can move through without obstruction.
• Remove any dead or dry shrub material closest to the house.
• Maintain open ground between shrub clusters and the walls of each structure.
